title: HR Expense + Project Expense → Invoice Chain
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P2 Supporting Domains

key_findings.expense_state_machine: hr.expense has 7 states: draft, submitted, approved, posted, in_payment, paid, refused. State is computed from approval_state + account_move.state + account_move.payment_state. A separate approval_state field (submitted/approved/refused) drives the pre-accounting workflow.
key_findings.no_sheet_model: Odoo 19 Community does NOT have hr.expense.sheet. The sheet aggregation model was removed. Expenses are posted individually, grouped only by employee at the time of move creation (_prepare_receipts_vals groups by employee_id).
key_findings.account_move_dr_cr: Employee-paid expenses create move_type='in_receipt' (vendor receipt). DR: expense account (_get_base_account), CR: employee payable (partner.property_account_payable_id). Company-paid expenses create an account.payment + linked move; DR: expense account, CR: outstanding payment account.
key_findings.project_integration: No project_id field on hr.expense in Community. Project link is via analytic_distribution matching the project's analytic account. Module project_hr_expense seeds analytic_distribution from project context at create time. Module project_sale_expense adds SO+project analytic reconciliation at post time.
key_findings.billable_invoice_chain: Module sale_expense adds sale_order_id + sale_order_line_id to hr.expense. Billability controlled by product.expense_policy ('no'/'cost'/'sales_price'). On posting the vendor receipt move, account.move.line._sale_can_be_reinvoice() determines if the line should generate a SOL. _sale_determine_order() maps expense move lines to their sale.order. _sale_prepare_sale_line_values() creates/updates the SOL with expense_ids backlink. Customer invoice is then generated from the SOL as part of the normal sale.order invoicing flow.
key_findings.project_sale_expense: Module project_sale_expense (present in Community) bridges project and SO analytic distributions for expenses; when both exist it merges or prioritizes project analytic.

open_questions: No hr.expense.sheet model found — previous units referencing 'sheet' model should be flagged for review.
The invoice_policy on SOL determines whether billable expense appears on customer invoice at ordered or delivered qty; expense always uses delivered qty path via qty_delivered on SOL.
